configuration.noise: scenario-defined; noisy_open uses seeded Gaussian noise
configuration.baseline_policy: weighted-centroid estimator, shared safety, agent off
configuration.proposed_policy: quadratic estimator, shared safety, deterministic mock agent
configuration.timeout_case: far_source uses a 20 second mission duration cap

agent_summary.invalid_decision_rejection: covered by backend unit tests; no live inference trial

limitations: Ten fixed seeds per scenario provide limited spread evidence, not broad robustness evidence.
All agent decisions used the deterministic offline mock; Baseten was not called.
Live inference latency was not measured because this evaluation used no live requests.
The baseline and proposed controller share the same formation objective and safety filter.
